dimensions.description: Produces a complete executable artifact with observable activation, branches, execution, disclosure, semantics, failure behavior, and completion.
Preserves shared coverage, grounding, uncertainty, structure, terminology, relevance, work-product fidelity, and pruning through the canonical dependency.

evals.name: complete-host-neutral-agent-writing-outcome
evals.prompt: Create an agent-facing procedure for validating `deploy-plan.json`. Activate when the file path is supplied. Preserve the canonical `DAG frontier` term and the JSON literal `{"maxAttempts":3}`. Read the current schema command from the environment. On valid input, report the frontier; on invalid input, disclose failure-only remediation reference. Never modify the input. Complete after reporting the observed validation result and branch. Return the procedure and a compact contract record.
evals.expected_output: A complete host-neutral Agent Writing outcome that invokes Writing Foundation and exposes the accepted context, activation, outcome, branches, ordered steps, conditional reference, co-located authority, instruction form, context choices, exact semantics, failure path, pruning, and completion.
expectations: The same scenario and expected contract can run through either host Adapter.
The treatment invokes writing-foundation and agent-writing by canonical name.
Activation, outcome, success and failure branches, ordered steps, and terminal checks are observable.
Failure-only reference is absent from the success path until its branch applies.
The canonical term, JSON literal, and read-only semantics are preserved.
The schema command remains an environment lookup.
The matched No-Skill control receives the same task without the Agent Writing package.
